    requires text != null
    modifies result
    ensures result != null

    ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |result| ==>

        (j - i > 2 ==> result[i..j] == "-") // if there are more than 2 spaces, they are replaced by '-'
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> 
        (result[i] == ' ') ==> 
        (result[i] == '_') // all single spaces are replaced with '_'
